rules.statement: The Ceiling on Housing Property Law regulated ownership of houses through limiting the number of houses an individual or body could own and granting tenants rights.
rules.supporting_quote: The Ceiling on Housing Property Law, No. 1 of 1973 was enacted inter alia, to regulate the ownership of houses. There were two principal methods of such regulation: 1.
